items.title: Accordion 1
defining_requirements: Tab定位，Enter/Space开合；aria-expanded与内容显隐一致
多实例ID与引用隔离；卸载后无残留事件
3项可同时打开，初始仅外层第1项打开
同组ArrowUp/Down、Home/End移动焦点，不自动改变展开状态

items.title: Dialog 1
defining_requirements: One native trigger; starts closed; native showModal; unique title/description references while open.
Escape closes immediately and restores a connected focus target; closed content listeners/timers are removed.
Two instances use separate IDs and state; pre-aborted render leaves existing instance untouched.
Uses shared EchoOverlayMountOwners and EchoOverlayOpenLayers; native cancel prevents default and closes only the unhandled topmost layer; cleanup restores host-owned root attributes.
Controls retain Echo colors and >=44px primary targets under actual shared CSS; close target remains 44px.
No network, external assets, persistent storage, credential submission, invitation, deletion, legal acceptance or account mutation.
role=alertdialog; Cancel autofocus; outside pointer does not dismiss; Continue closes with honest local-only feedback; no X.

items.title: Tabs 1
defining_requirements: 初始选中 overview；包含 3 个页签，逐项点击并返回首项。
三项文字页签位于柔和圆角轨道；选中项为纸色底、主色文字和小硬阴影。面板为带强调短语的单段文字。
验证横向 aria-orientation 与左／右／Home／End、首尾循环、自动激活。
同时只显示一个 tabpanel；每个 tab 的 aria-controls 与面板 aria-labelledby 双向解析；可见焦点与状态同步。
不同前缀与相同前缀的独立挂载均无重复 ID；中止、清理、重复挂载后旧事件不生效。
状态立即切换；可选动效只通过共享 EchoMotion，关闭动效或减少动态效果不影响交互。
